title: Fixed affine additive coefficient augmentation quasi-isomorphism
statement: Let X be a separated scheme, U a finite family of opens with every positive tuple intersection affine, and I an injective resolution of X.etaleAdditiveSheaf. There is a chain map b from the ordinary unit cechOver X.toSpecGamma U complex, after forgetting module scalars and applying AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor, to additiveCechTotal U I. For every degree n and ordinary cochain x, b.f n (ULift.up x)=additiveCechBeta U I n x, and b is a quasi-isomorphism. No covering condition or compactness assumption is required.

source.place: Theorem 59.22.4, affine vanishing and separated affine intersections; Tag 01EQ Lemma 20.11.2, beta from the resolution augmentation; Tag 0133 Lemma 12.25.4, first-quadrant double-complex comparison.

proof.text: Use the explicit product coordinate maps and their horizontal compatibility to construct a:A → D.flip.X 0. Their vertical differential vanishes by the evaluated resolution augmentation identity.

Construct a chain map b:A → Tot(D.flip) by composing a.f n with the (0,n) inclusion. The two total differential terms are respectively zero by vertical annihilation and the image of the coefficient differential by a.comm. Apply the first-quadrant column augmentation criterion with the fixed affine column quasi-isomorphisms.

Compose b with D.totalFlipIso, using the explicit natural-number sign (-1)^(p*q). The total inclusion component formula has sign +1 on (n,0); therefore the composed map has exactly additiveCechBeta components. Composition with an isomorphism preserves quasi-isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Theorem 59.22.4 and Tag 01EQ, beta; explicit chain-map construction, first-quadrant criterion and signed total transpose.

theorem exists_additiveCech_beta_quasiIso
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [X.IsSeparated] {ι : Type u} [Finite ι]
    (U : ι → X.Opens)
    (hU : ∀ (k : ℕ) (y : Fin (k + 1) → ι), IsAffineOpen (⨅ l, U (y l)))
    (I : InjectiveResolution X.etaleAdditiveSheaf) :
    ∃ b : (((forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
        AddCommGrpCat.uliftFunctor.{u + 1, u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj
          (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf))) ⟶
        additiveCechTotal U I,
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : (cechOver X.toSpecΓ U
        (SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)).X n),
        b.f n (ULift.up x) = additiveCechBeta U I n x) ∧ QuasiIso b
